events.title: Catholics and Huguenots clash at Dreux
events.description: The first major battle of the French Wars of Religion was fought at Dreux, west of Paris. Both armies' commanders were captured, and the bloody outcome showed the war would be long.
events.html: The first major battle of the French Wars of Religion was fought at Dreux, west of Paris. Both armies' commanders were captured, and the bloody outcome showed the war would be long.

events.title: Washington's army goes into winter quarters at Valley Forge
events.description: About 12,000 Continental soldiers marched into camp at Valley Forge, Pennsylvania. Some 2,000 died of disease over the winter, but drilling under Baron von Steuben made the survivors a more effective army.
events.html: About 12,000 Continental soldiers marched into camp at Valley Forge, Pennsylvania. Some 2,000 died of disease over the winter, but drilling under Baron von Steuben made the survivors a more effective army.

events.title: Charles Dickens publishes A Christmas Carol
events.description: Charles Dickens's novella about the miser Ebenezer Scrooge went on sale and sold out its first printing by Christmas Eve. It shaped Victorian ideals of a charitable, family-centred Christmas.
events.html: Charles Dickens's novella about the miser Ebenezer Scrooge went on sale and sold out its first printing by Christmas Eve. It shaped Victorian ideals of a charitable, family-centred Christmas.

events.title: The House impeaches President Clinton
events.description: The US House of Representatives impeached Bill Clinton for perjury and obstruction of justice related to the Monica Lewinsky affair. The Senate acquitted him in February 1999.
